newsitem.title: USA: Imagyn holders to get more UroHealth stock.
newsitem.headline: Imagyn holders to get more UroHealth stock.

text.p: UroHealth Systems Inc said Friday terms of its merger with Imagyn Medical Inc have been amended, increasing the number of UroHealth shares to be exchanged for each Imagyn share to 1.4 from the 1.0358 announced April 19.
UroHealth also said executive vice president and chief financial officer James Johnson has resigned.

The company has retained a search firm as part of its effort to recruit a replacement. Until a successor has been selected, Joseph Artino, vice president of finance, will assume the responsibilities of chief financial officer on an interim basis.
UroHealth said it would issue about 11.4 million shares to Imagyn holders.

The company said the merger agreement was revised "to eflect the share price of our stock, because of our strong belief this merger will provide UroHealth with a platform into the gynecological market."
